name: mcp-gitnexus
description: MCP server package for GitNexus code-intelligence: knowledge-graph queries over an indexed repository (execution flows, symbol context, impact/blast radius, call-path tracing). Ships the server config with SHARP_IGNORE_GLOBAL_LIBVIPS=1 so the npx install never source-builds sharp against a host libvips, plus steering on when graph queries beat text search and semantic tools.
